$comment: REL-03: components redistributed in packages that are not Cargo or npm packages. Each text file in this folder is a verbatim copy from the named origin. scripts/notices/generate-notices.mjs reads this file.

components.name: Rust standard library
components.source: rustc 1.99.1 (58cf8f9c35b355199727627d07ae34a4e2846d67, 2026-10-13), statically linked into every Downova binary; COPYRIGHT-library.html copied verbatim from the toolchain (sha256 5647be074c8edf7339fd863055923a8fc80bc5610a8d4661ec3b767b9d392c27)

components.name: NSIS (installer stub and plug-ins)
components.source: NSIS 3.13 as downloaded by the Tauri CLI 2.12.3; the Tauri NSIS template uses `SetCompressor /SOLID "{{compression}}"` with the default lzma (Downova sets no compression), so the stub carries NSIS (zlib/libpng) and its LZMA module (CPL-1.0); bzip2 is not used

components.name: nsis_tauri_utils (NSIS plug-in)
components.source: nsis_tauri_utils.dll pinned by the Tauri CLI 2.12.3 (release nsis_tauri_utils-v0.5.3, SHA-1 75197fee3c6a814fe035788d1c34ead39349b860; the local DLL matches); license files from tag commit 13d9edd27b69310e108d6fbd49f90992f8a05390

components.name: WiX Toolset UI and extension resources
components.source: WiX Toolset 3.14 (wix314-binaries.zip, sha256 6ac824e1642d6f7277d0ed7ea09411a508f6116ba6fae0aa5f2c7daa2ff43d31) as pinned by the Tauri CLI 2.12.3; the MSI uses the WixUI_InstallDir dialog set (WixUIExtension) and WixUtilExtension
unresolved: the exact candle/light -ext arguments are inferred from strings in the Tauri CLI binary, not decoded from its source; confirm against the tauri-bundler 2.x WiX invocation

components.name: Microsoft WebView2 loader (WebView2LoaderStatic.lib)
components.source: statically linked into the Windows desktop executable through webview2-com-sys 0.39.1, which vendors WebView2LoaderStatic.lib byte-identical to Microsoft.Web.WebView2 1.0.3800.47 (nupkg sha256 56c9f26bdd07916a2d1949fb58a5c7e434dfa1173577dca879206050c4e718db); LICENSE.txt and NOTICE.txt copied verbatim from that package

components.name: Vite runtime helpers (module preload)
components.source: Vite's modulepreload polyfill and __vitePreload helper are emitted into the desktop web bundle by vite 8.3.4 (node_modules, pnpm-lock.yaml); LICENSE.md copied verbatim from the installed package

components.name: rolldown runtime helpers (CommonJS interop)
components.source: rolldown 1.2.14 (Vite's bundler) emits its CommonJS interop helpers into the desktop web bundle; LICENSE and THIRD-PARTY-LICENSE copied verbatim from the installed package

external.name: aria2
external.reason: not bundled in any package (ADR 0005, REL-05); used only with --backend aria2 and a user-supplied or fetched binary. Bundling it would require its GPL-2.0-or-later notices and corresponding source.

external.name: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime
external.reason: not embedded; Windows provides it, and the installer downloads Microsoft's bootstrapper only when it is missing

external.name: System WebView (WKWebView on macOS, WebKitGTK on Linux) and system libraries
external.reason: provided by the operating system or the package manager; not redistributed
